lines.en: label halloweenfour9:
scene karinimaniamitalk1
: Ughhhhh. These shoes are killing me. I should have listened to my mom and gotten my own instead of borrowing hers.
lines.zh: 呜呜呜。这双鞋要我的命。我早该听我妈的话自己买一双，而不是借她的。

lines.en: : Just take them off. Ain’t nobody gonna give a shit. People know better than to mess with brides by now.
lines.zh: 脱了不就得了。没人会他妈在乎的。现在谁都清楚别去招惹新娘。

lines.en: : No. I’ll just continue to suffer in silence until my feet need to be amputated and I’m never able to kick a soccer ball again. Or anything for that matter because...you know. No feet.
lines.zh: 不。我就继续默默受苦，直到我的脚需要被截掉，从此再也没法踢足球。或者说别的什么也干不了，因为……你懂的。没脚了。

lines.en: : I think kicking stuff will be the least of your worries if things come to that, Karin.
lines.zh: Karin，真到那一步的话，我觉得踢东西该是你最不用操心的事了。

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk2
: True. But, on the bright side, I wouldn’t tower over everyone anymore. And that sounds like it might be kind of nice.
lines.zh: 说得也是。不过往好处想，我就不会再高出所有人一大截了。听起来好像还挺不错的。

lines.en: : For real. All these tiny bitches got me feeling like Shaq up in here. Which would probably make you Yao Ming since you’re even taller than I am.
lines.zh: 真的。这儿一堆小矮个儿，搞得我像沙克一样。那你应该就是姚明了，毕竟你比我还高。

lines.en: : And better at shooting free throws.
lines.zh: 而且罚球比他准。

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk3
: Now, how the hell do you know that? Ain’t neither of those two played since you were learning how to write yo’ damn name.
lines.zh: 你他妈是怎么知道的？这俩人打球那会儿你还在学写自己的鬼名字呢。

lines.en: : My dad’s big on American sports. It’s probably how I wound up getting into them in the first place. The two of us used to watch basketball together and I just remember being impressed by their...size.
lines.zh: 我爸超迷美国体育。我大概就是这么入坑的。我们俩以前一起看篮球，我就记得自己被他们的……尺寸给震住了。

lines.en: : Fuck was that pause for? Picked a damn weird time to hesitate, girl. Get your mind out of the gutter.
lines.zh: 你他妈停顿个什么劲？姑娘，挑这会儿犹豫可真够怪的。别满脑子下流念头。

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk4
: I don’t {i}know{/i} why I hesitated! It just happened! I was probably just...distracted by thinking about how big they are!
lines.zh: 我不{i}知道{/i}我为什么犹豫！它就是发生了！我大概只是……想着它们有多大，走了神！

lines.en: : You’d be diggin’ yourself into a hell of a hole right now if I was legally allowed to make sex jokes to you.
lines.zh: 要是我对你开黄腔不犯法，你现在已经把自己挖进一个大坑里了。

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk5
: Shh! Don’t say the “S” word in public! It’s inappropriate and you’re going to rile Kirin up.
lines.zh: 嘘！别在公共场合说那个「性」字！不合适，而且你会把 Kirin 给惹兴奋的。

lines.en: : Oh, please. That girl’s been riled up since she hit puberty and she ain’t comin’ down any time soon. Especially not with a sister who was conceived by what I can only imagine as a fuckin’...cloud and a smile.
lines.zh: 得了吧。那丫头从青春期起就一直亢奋着，短期内是降不下来的。尤其她还有个姐姐——我只能想象，那姐姐是被一朵他妈的……云和一个微笑造出来的。

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk6
: It was only a minute ago that I was telling a story about my dad. Don’t go replacing him with a cloud just because Kirin is...{i}maturing{/i} at a frightening pace.
lines.zh: 我一分钟前还在讲我爸的事呢。别因为 Kirin 正以吓人的速度……{i}发育{/i}，就拿一朵云来顶替他。

lines.en: : At least you’re willing to acknowledge it. Was starting to worry you were so deep in your own world that you didn’t even realize what kind of shit she’s into.
lines.zh: 至少你还肯承认。我刚才还担心你沉浸在自己的世界里，压根没意识到她都迷上些什么玩意儿。

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk7
: It would be hard {i}not{/i} to after watching her make a complete fool of herself during that God-awful swimsuit competition.
lines.zh: 看过她在那个烂透了的泳装比赛上出尽洋相之后，想{i}不{/i}注意到都难。

lines.en: : Poor Sensei, being forced to quietly sit through all of that and choose a winner. He must have felt so uncomfortable.
lines.zh: 可怜的 Sensei，被迫安安静静地看完全程还要选出个优胜者。他当时一定很不自在。

lines.en: : Yeah. Poor him. It must have been Hell.
lines.zh: 是啊。好可怜。那一定是人间地狱。

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk8
: That’s enough of that, though. I have news.
lines.zh: 不过这事就到这儿吧。我有消息。

lines.en: : You do? Is it about the Ami thing?
lines.zh: 是吗？是关于 Ami 那件事吗？

lines.en: : It is. But I did not say it was good news.
lines.zh: 是。但我可没说是好消息。

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk9
: Man, then what in Shaq’s sack is that smile for? Fuckin’ wholesome ass face got me thinkin’ you cracked the case wide open.
lines.zh: 那你到底在笑个屁？你那张纯真到爆的脸害我还以为你把案子彻底破了呢。

lines.en: : Quite the opposite actually. I’m just smiling because life is great and I’m happy to have been invited to the Halloween party again.
lines.zh: 其实正好相反。我笑只是因为生活很美好，而且我很高兴又能被邀请来万圣节派对。

lines.en: : Spill it, then. What’s the “news?”
lines.zh: 那就快说吧。到底是什么「消息」？

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk10
: The news is mostly just that...there isn’t much news at all. And what I mean by that is my dad can’t find any “hard” evidence connecting Ami to the girl from his class.
lines.zh: 消息主要就是……其实没什么消息。我的意思是，我爸找不到任何把 Ami 和他班上那个女生联系起来的「硬」证据。

lines.en: : We went through all of his old yearbooks together and couldn’t find a single picture of her.
lines.zh: 我们一起翻遍了他所有的旧年鉴，一张她的照片都没找到。

lines.en: : But, according to him, she was one of those “Only shows up to class when she wants to” types. So I guess it makes sense that she wouldn’t have gone to class picture day.
lines.zh: 不过据他说，她是那种「想来上课才来」的人。所以她没去拍班级合照也算说得通。

lines.en: : So, what you’re saying is we ain’t got shit.
lines.zh: 所以你的意思是，我们什么都没捞着。

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk11
: Yes!
lines.zh: 没错！

lines.en: : Lord have mercy.
lines.zh: 老天爷发发慈悲吧。

lines.en: : But!
lines.zh: 但是！

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk12
: But?
lines.zh: 但是？

lines.en: : He thinks he remembers her name. Or...her {i}given{/i} name at least.
lines.zh: 他觉得他记得她的名字。或者至少……她的{i}名{/i}。

lines.en: : Correct me if I’m wrong here, but shouldn’t it be the other way around? Cause unless your dad and Ami-Mommy were studying over in the west, that shit’s kinda weird.
lines.zh: 要是我说错了你纠正我，但这不该是反过来的吗？除非你爸和 Ami 妈咪当年是在西方留的学，不然这就有点怪了。

lines.en: : I believe the word he used to describe her was ”eccentric” and that she wouldn’t respond to her family name.
lines.zh: 我记得他形容她用的词是「古怪」，而且她听到别人叫她的姓是不应的。

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk13
: Well, that might be something to go off of. Makes looking her up a little harder since the registry ain’t gonna tell us shit without a family name, but it’s better than nothing I guess.
lines.zh: 嗯，这好歹是个线索。没有姓氏的话户籍登记也查不出个屁来，找起来会难一点，但总比什么都没有强吧。

lines.en: : I agree. I’m really sorry I couldn’t help any more, though. But I know you and Miss Watabe will do everything you can to help Ami.
lines.zh: 我同意。不过我真的很抱歉只能帮到这儿。但我知道你和渡部小姐会尽全力帮 Ami 的。

lines.en: : The name, Karin. What is it?
lines.zh: 名字，Karin。到底是什么？

lines.en: : Oh, sorry. It’s S-
lines.zh: 哦，抱歉。是 S-

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk14
: Hi! What are you guys talking about?
lines.zh: 嗨！你们在聊什么呢？

lines.en: : Salvador Dali!
lines.zh: 萨尔瓦多·达利！

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk15
: Sal...vation...Dolly?
lines.zh: 萨……尔瓦……多莉？

lines.en: : Yup! That’s him!
lines.zh: 对！就是他！

lines.en: : You can finish telling me about {i}Salvador Dali{/i} later, Karin. We don’t want to bore Ami with all of our...famous painter facts.
lines.zh: Karin，{i}萨尔瓦多·达利{/i}的事你可以待会儿再跟我讲完。我们可不想拿一堆……著名画家的冷知识把 Ami 给闷着。

lines.en: : Don’t let me stop you. I have a few minutes to kill while Sensei is outside. So, what’s all this about famous painters? What kind of facts do you know?
lines.zh: 别因为我停下来。Sensei 在外面，我还有几分钟可以打发。所以，著名画家是怎么回事？你们都知道些什么？

lines.en: : Van Gogh chopped his ear off! And...uhh...Picasso was a cube!
lines.zh: 梵高把自己的耳朵割下来了！还有……呃……毕加索是个立方体！

lines.en: : You weren’t talking about painting at all, were you?
lines.zh: 你们根本不是在聊画画，对吧？

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk16
: No, Ami. We weren’t talking about painting. But we were talking about something private and I think we’d both appreciate it a lot if you stopped prying and just left it at that.
lines.zh: 对，Ami。我们不是在聊画画。但我们聊的是私事，如果你别再打听、就此打住，我和她都会很感激。

lines.en: : Sorry, Miss Imai. I’ve heard I can be kind of suffocating at times. But I promise I wasn’t trying to stop you from breathing or anything like that. I was just curious.
lines.zh: 抱歉，Imai 老师。我听说我有时候挺让人窒息的。但我保证我不是想让你喘不过气什么的。我只是好奇。

lines.en: : Well...thank you for...not wanting to suffocate me. I’ll remember that when it comes time to grade your next quiz.
lines.zh: 嗯……谢谢你……不想让我窒息。下次给你批小测的时候我会记住的。

lines.en: : Oh, you don’t have to go out of your way for me. I know I can be a real idiot when it comes to schoolwork sometimes, but I can still hold my own when I have to.
lines.zh: 哦，你不用为我破例。我知道我有时候在功课上确实挺笨的，但真要拼的时候我还是撑得住的。

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk17

: You’re not an idiot, Ami. Senpai’s probably just been a little too easy on you for your whole ass life and that’s just {i}now{/i} catching up to you. But it ain’t nothing a little overtime won’t fix.
lines.zh: 你不是笨蛋，Ami。大概只是 Senpai 对你这一整辈子都太放水了，而{i}现在{/i}才刚开始找上门来。不过加点班就能补回来。

lines.en: : Are you saying that Sensei has done a bad job raising me?
lines.zh: 你是说 Sensei 没把我教好吗？

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk18
: What?
lines.zh: 什么？

lines.en: : Are you saying Sensei has failed me? That you’d have raised me differently? That he’s not loving me the way he’s supposed to?
lines.zh: 你是说 Sensei 辜负了我吗？说换作你会把我教得不一样？说他没有用该有的方式爱我？

lines.en: : Uhh...let’s back up for a second. I think there might be some sort of misunderstanding here.
lines.zh: 呃……我们倒回去一下。我觉得这里可能是有什么误会。

lines.en: : I don’t know anything about raising {i}anyone.{/i} I just know that there are academic levels girls your age are expected to reach and...you are {i}slightly{/i} beneath them. That’s all I’m saying.
lines.zh: 我对怎么{i}养孩子{/i}一窍不通。我只知道你这个年纪的女孩应该达到什么样的学业水平，而你……{i}稍微{/i}差了那么一点。我就说了这个。

lines.en: : Do you want children one day, Miss Imai?
lines.zh: Imai 老师，你将来想要孩子吗？

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk19
: This...is taking a weird turn.
lines.zh: 这……走向有点怪啊。

lines.en: : Do you think you’d be a good mom?
lines.zh: 你觉得你会是个好妈妈吗？

lines.en: : I...haven’t put much thought into that just yet...
lines.zh: 我……还没怎么想过这个……

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: 我明白了。

lines.en: : Ami...sorry if this is blunt, but...are you doing okay? Cause you seem kinda...{i}not{/i} okay right now. And by “kinda” I mean you seem really not okay.
lines.zh: Ami……我这么说可能有点直，但是……你还好吗？因为你现在看起来有点……{i}不{/i}太好。而「有点」的意思是，你看起来真的很不好。

lines.en: : {i}I{/i} want kids some day.
lines.zh: {i}我{/i}将来想要孩子。

lines.en: : A lot of them.
lines.zh: 要很多个。

lines.en: : I’m good at taking care of people.
lines.zh: 我很会照顾人。

lines.en: : In fact, I’ve been taking care of Sensei since long before you were even employed here.
lines.zh: 事实上，早在你受雇来这儿之前，我就一直在照顾 Sensei 了。

lines.en: : Ami, hold up. This-
lines.zh: Ami，等一下。这-

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk20
: Which is why I {i}really{/i} hope you were being honest when you said there was a {i}misunderstanding{/i} just now.
lines.zh: 所以我{i}真的{/i}希望你刚才说那是{i}误会{/i}的时候是诚实的。

lines.en: : Because, if there is anything I don’t like, it’s when people talk badly about my uncle. You shouldn’t do that, Miss Imai.
lines.zh: 因为，如果有什么事是我不喜欢的，那就是别人说我叔叔的坏话。你不该那样，Imai 老师。

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk21
: Girl, you ain’t got the faintest idea how I feel about your damn uncle.
lines.zh: 丫头，你对你那个叔叔在我心里是什么位置，连半点概念都没有。

lines.en: : What is that supposed to mean?
lines.zh: 你这话是什么意思？

lines.en: : It’s supposed to mean that I ain’t tryin’ to talk down on the guy. I just want you to learn more shit. Ain’t no reason to get all Hannibal Lecter on me.
lines.zh: 意思就是我没打算贬低他。我只是想让你多学点东西。没必要跟我摆出一副汉尼拔·莱克特的架势。

lines.en: : You’d understand if you were in my shoes. But you don’t have anything to protect, so you don’t get it at all.
lines.zh: 你要是站在我的位置就会懂了。可你没有什么要守护的东西，所以你根本不明白。

lines.en: : Ami-
lines.zh: Ami-

lines.en: : It’s rude to talk about people while they’re not around.
lines.zh: 在别人不在场的时候议论别人很没礼貌。

lines.en: : But it’s nothing compared to thinking you need to {i}fix{/i} them.
lines.zh: 但比起觉得你需要去{i}修好{/i}他们，这根本不算什么。

lines.en: : Ami, Miss Imai is just trying to-
lines.zh: Ami，Imai 老师只是想-

lines.en: : She should stop.
lines.zh: 她该停下来了。

lines.en: : You both should.
lines.zh: 你们两个都该停下来。

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk22
: Why is this human button a rotating plastic lever? I am incapable of pushing in that which refuses to be pushed!
lines.zh: 为什么这个人类按钮是个会旋转的塑料拨杆？我没办法把拒绝被按下的东西按进去！

lines.en: : It’s called an analog stick, Kaori. You use it to move your character around — which I highly recommend you start doing before you die.
lines.zh: 那叫摇杆，Kaori。你用它来操控你的角色——我强烈建议你在死掉之前赶紧开始动起来。

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk23
: I was not properly made aware of the potential consequences this game could have on my life! Human technology has become far too advanced in far too short of a time!
lines.zh: 没有人好好告诉过我，这个游戏可能会对我的生命造成什么后果！人类技术在太短的时间里变得太先进了！

lines.en: : This game is from, like...2002. Technology’s gotten a lot better since then.
lines.zh: 这游戏大概是……2002 年的。之后技术已经进步很多了。

lines.en: : I...hope it has advanced to...a point where it can no longer end our lives!
lines.zh: 我……希望它已经先进到……不能再夺走我们的性命了！

lines.en: : Hate to break it to you, but I think we’re actually ten times closer to what I can only imagine will be the inevitable truth of that fear being realized.
lines.zh: 我不想打击你，但我觉得我们离那个恐惧成真的必然事实，其实又近了十倍。

lines.en: : It fell asleep on me.
lines.zh: 它在我手上睡着了。

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk24
: Its name is Nao-chan and the sleep function engages when too many spoons have been left behind. You can re-engage her “awake” function by gently blowing mouth-wind into her hearing-holes.
lines.zh: 她叫 Nao-chan，当留下的勺子太多时，睡眠功能就会启动。你可以轻轻把嘴风吹进她的听觉孔里，重新启动她的「清醒」功能。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m not going to do that.
lines.zh: 行，我不会干那种事。

lines.en: : I respect your cotton decision, candy girl. Now, please lessen the movement of your vocal vibrations before Nao-chan wakes up in a new, undiscovered way.
lines.zh: 我尊重你这个棉花般的决定，糖果女孩。现在，请减弱你声带振动的幅度，免得 Nao-chan 以一种全新的、尚未被发现的方式醒来。

lines.en: : Yeah, Niki. Keep your voice down. We’re trying to be gamers over here.
lines.zh: 对啊，Niki。小声点。我们在这儿正努力当玩家呢。

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk25
: You sound like a forty year old woman pretending to be young again by engaging in young people activities.
lines.zh: 你听起来像个四十岁的女人，靠参加年轻人的活动来装年轻。

lines.en: : You mean like how you’re almost thirty and your fanbase still thinks you’re like...what was it? Twelve?
lines.zh: 你是说就像你快三十了，你的粉丝团还以为你……多少来着？十二？

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk26
: Listen here, you little shit. I-
lines.zh: 你给我听好了，你这个小混蛋。我-

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk27
: Shh!
lines.zh: 嘘！

lines.en: : Oh, right. Childspawn.
lines.zh: 哦，对。幼崽。

lines.en: : Continued usage of the stretchy voice tubes in your head-holder will separate her vision balls from the thin layers of flesh currently obscuring them.
lines.zh: 你头壳里那些有弹性的声音管子再继续用下去，会把她的眼球从正遮着它们的薄薄皮肉上剥离下来。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m aware. I just haven’t had to deal with this since Noriko was a toddler.
lines.zh: 行，我知道。只是自打 Noriko 还是个学步小孩以后，我就没再处理过这种事了。

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk28
: What is a “Noriko” and why does it no longer “toddle?”
lines.zh: 「Noriko」是什么，为什么它不再「学步」了？

lines.en: : Noriko’s her sister. Think Niki but...less hot.
lines.zh: Noriko 是她妹妹。就当是 Niki，但……没那么辣。

lines.en: : By how many degrees?
lines.zh: 低多少度？

lines.en: : At least seven.
lines.zh: 至少七度。

lines.en: : Seven degrees below normal human body temperature could be fatal. I now understand why the Noriko no longer toddles.
lines.zh: 比正常人体温低七度可能会致命。我现在明白 Noriko 为什么不再学步了。

lines.en: : Having fun over there, Niki?
lines.zh: 那边玩得开心吗，Niki？

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk29
: Not particularly.
lines.zh: 不怎么开心。

lines.en: : I guess I don’t hate it, though.
lines.zh: 不过我倒也不讨厌。

lines.en: : This one’s fine because she doesn’t make noise even when she’s awake. Plus, she’s a lot cuter without that stupid hat on.
lines.zh: 这个还行，因为她醒着的时候也不出声。而且她不戴那顶蠢帽子可爱多了。

lines.en: : Nao-chan chose that cranial covering herself! It is {i}your{/i} soft skull-protector that is stupid! Hers is beautiful and reinforces the idea of criminal justice!
lines.zh: Nao-chan 那顶颅顶覆盖物是她自己选的！蠢的是{i}你{/i}那个软质护头器！她的很漂亮，还强化了刑事司法的理念！

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk30
: Sure...whatever...sorry.
lines.zh: 行吧……随便吧……抱歉。

lines.en: : Woah. You’re not even going to clap back? You getting baby fever over there or something?
lines.zh: 哇哦。你居然不回嘴了？你那边是犯了宝宝瘾还是怎么的？

lines.en: : Me? Absolutely not. Didn't I {i}just{/i} mention not wanting kids when we were upstairs?
lines.zh: 我？绝对没有。我们刚才在楼上我不是{i}刚刚{/i}才说过不想要孩子吗？

lines.en: : Besides, I’d be a terrible mother.
lines.zh: 再说，我会是个糟糕透顶的母亲。

lines.en: : Why do you say that, fluffy pink sugar-ball?
lines.zh: 你为什么这么说，毛茸茸的粉色糖球？

lines.en: : Well, for one, I’d have zero time to spend with a daughter.
lines.zh: 首先，我根本没有时间陪女儿。

lines.en: : Kinda weird that you’ve already chosen the sex of the baby you’re not going to have.
lines.zh: 你都决定不生了，却连孩子的性别都选好了，这有点怪吧。

lines.en: : Of course I’d have a girl. Boys suck and I’d just return a son if I ever had one.
lines.zh: 我当然要女孩。男生最讨厌了，万一真生了儿子我就退货。

lines.en: : To...where?
lines.zh: 退到……哪儿？

lines.en: : I think a bigger problem than just the time thing, though, is that...I’m just not really sure if I’d be able to love it.
lines.zh: 不过我觉得比时间更严重的问题是……我不太确定自己能不能爱它。

lines.en: : And now {i}she’s{/i} an {i}it?{/i}
lines.zh: 现在{i}她{/i}又变成{i}它{/i}了？

lines.en: : I’m already spread thin wasting all of my worries on my stupid boyfriend. And the shitty truth is that I have a finite amount of love to give, so it’s not like I’m going to make {i}him{/i} suffer instead of some {i}kid.{/i}
lines.zh: 我光是把操心都浪费在那个蠢男友身上就已经分身乏术了。而操蛋的事实是，我能给出的爱是有上限的，所以我不可能为了某个{i}小孩{/i}就让{i}他{/i}受委屈。

lines.en: : Especially one I barely even know.
lines.zh: 尤其是一个我几乎都不认识的小孩。

lines.en: : I read inside the guts of a dead tree that mothermoms imprint on their children the way birds imprint on other birds. So I believe you {i}would{/i} know the childspawn. Or at least {i}feel{/i} like you do.
lines.zh: 我在一棵死树的内脏里读到过，妈妈母亲会像鸟对别的鸟那样对自己的孩子产生印记。所以我相信你{i}会{/i}认识那个幼崽的。或者至少{i}感觉{/i}上认识。

lines.en: : Maybe that’s true. Maybe there {i}is{/i} something special about the bond between a mother and her child...I’ve always loved {i}my{/i} parents, after all. And I never needed a reason to do that...
lines.zh: 也许是真的。也许母亲和孩子之间的纽带{i}确实{/i}有什么特别的地方……毕竟我一直都爱{i}我的{/i}父母。而我从来不需要任何理由去爱他们……

lines.en: : But what if my kid doesn’t like me? Or what if I don’t like them? What if they take after their stupid fucking dad and just bitch and moan all day long about literally nothing?
lines.zh: 可要是我的孩子不喜欢我呢？或者我不喜欢他们呢？要是他们随了那个蠢到爆的爹，整天为了屁大点事抱怨个没完呢？

lines.en: : And here I thought you {i}loved{/i} those qualities in Sensei.
lines.zh: 我还以为你{i}爱{/i}的就是 Sensei 身上这些特质呢。

lines.en: : Obviously not, Otoha. But just because I love {i}him{/i} doesn’t mean I love everything {i}about{/i} him. He annoys me more than everyone else in the world combined.
lines.zh: 显然不是，Otoha。但我爱{i}他{/i}，不代表他{i}身上{/i}的一切我都爱。他烦我的程度，比世上其他人加起来还甚。

lines.en: : Hey, cool. I was worried I might be in first place after Christmas.
lines.zh: 嘿，不错。我还担心圣诞节之后我会排第一呢。

lines.en: : Keep bringing it up and you might take the lead. But, for now...
lines.zh: 你再提下去说不定真能登顶。不过，现在嘛……

lines.en: : It’s only him.
lines.zh: 只有他一个。

lines.en: : And he’ll never want kids. He wouldn’t be able to handle them.
lines.zh: 而他永远都不会想要孩子。他应付不来的。

lines.en: : He’s too...fragile.
lines.zh: 他太……脆弱了。

lines.en: : He seems to handle Ami just fine and she’s basically his kid.
lines.zh: 他对付 Ami 看起来不是挺好嘛，而且她基本就是他女儿了。

lines.en: : Those two handle {i}each other.{/i} And after what they’ve gone through, I don’t think it’s really fair to compare their bond to...well, {i}anything.{/i}
lines.zh: 那两个人是{i}互相{/i}应付。而且经历了那些事之后，我觉得拿他们之间的纽带去跟……嗯，{i}任何东西{/i}比都不公平。

lines.en: : Besides, Ami will probably be in college by the time Akira’s ready to settle down. So we won’t even have her to look after the kid when we both inevitably want nothing to do with it. Or her. Or whatever.
lines.zh: 再说，等 Akira 准备安顿下来的时候，Ami 大概都上大学了。所以等我们俩不可避免地都不想管那个孩子的时候，连她都没法帮我们带。或者说她。或者随便什么。

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t think finding a babysitter with your income would be a particularly difficult thing to do. Just saying.
lines.zh: 是啊，我觉得以你的收入找个保姆应该不是什么难事。随口一提。

lines.en: : Yeah. Maybe not.
lines.zh: 嗯。也许吧。

lines.en: : I guess having one on accident wouldn’t be the end of the world, though.
lines.zh: 不过我猜，不小心怀上一个也不算世界末日。

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk31
: I’d just want to skip the first, like...five years of its life. Or maybe six.
lines.zh: 我只是想跳过它人生的头……比如说五年。或者六年。

lines.en: : I’ll tag in once it hits seven.
lines.zh: 等它到七岁我再接手。

lines.en: : Mother of the year over here. Pretty soon, you’ll be-
lines.zh: 年度最佳母亲就在这儿。再过不久，你就要-

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk32
: Ahah! I have figured out the secrets of the plastic joyful twig!
lines.zh: 啊哈！我破解了这根塑料快乐树枝的秘密！

lines.en: : I’m the video game girl! I’m the one who wins!
lines.zh: 我是电子游戏女孩！赢的人是我！

lines.en: : Kaori, shh. Childspawn.
lines.zh: Kaori，嘘。幼崽。

lines.en: scene karinimaniamitalk33
: If you yell, she’ll...
lines.zh: 你要是喊，她会……

scene karinimaniamitalk35

lines.zh: {i}两个小时后……{/i}
